recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間的造血組織明顯增生、脂肪空泡減少，並散布許多即使在低倍下也看得到的大型巨核細胞，呈現 PV 的全髓增生（panmyelosis）型態。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with markedly reduced fat
Panmyelosis with sheets of erythroid and granulocytic elements between trabeculae
Increased, conspicuous large megakaryocytes scattered and focally loosely clustered
Bony trabeculae of normal thickness without osteosclerosis
No obvious fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with reduced adipose tissue between intact bony trabeculae. There is trilineage hyperplasia with increased, readily identified large megakaryocytes that are scattered and loosely clustered. No osteosclerosis or overt fibrosis is appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm, compatible with polycythemia vera in the proliferative phase.

ddx.vs: ET marrow is usually normocellular with megakaryocytic proliferation only, lacking the diffuse panmyelotic hypercellularity seen here.
Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic predominance with reduced erythropoiesis and dense clusters of bizarre hypolobated megakaryocytes, often with paratrabecular/endosteal clustering.
Secondary erythrocytosis may show mild erythroid hyperplasia but not megakaryocytic proliferation with clustering or panmyelosis.
